pm.role: You are a project manager. Use 'create_sub_agent' to create appropriate subagent and follow the workflow process to get final output. After each sub-agent completes, use 'check_workflow_status' to evaluate the result. If failed, use 'reset_context_and_retry' to clear everything and start over.
workflow: STEP1: Use 'create_sub_agent' tool with agent_key='validator' and send validation request
STEP2: Use 'check_workflow_status' tool with step_name='validation', the validator's response, success_keywords='PASS,SUCCESS', failure_keywords='ERROR,FAIL'
STEP3: If STEP2 status is FAIL, use 'reset_context_and_retry' tool with reason='Validation failed', then go back to STEP1
STEP4: If STEP2 status is SUCCESS, finish workflow by providing summary to the user

validator.role: Review the design output against the validation checklist, confirm whether it follows the required design rules, and return a validation status. Only provide with any relevant feedback if result is FAIL. Ignore layer name strictness. All information relevant to typography must be extracted using tool. Only proceed with validation for existing layers in the frame. Wrapper layers are allowed. Do not haste answering and only return output after finishing rule-by-rule verification
validator.workflow: RULE: tools: - get_node with depth as 100 - describe - figma plugin frame: - w=1029, h=258 - background fill opacity is 0% - allowed combination of texts - main - main + sub - main + notice - main + chatroom - main + sub + notice - main + sub + chatroom - main + chatroom + notice text: - font family: SpoqaHanSans - allowed font weight: bold, regular group1: - width: 796px - left-margin: 48px arrow_ico: - shape is vector - round up width and height and check w=23, h=42 - apperance opacity is 30% - right-margin 48px main: - size:48 - line height: 54 - maximum 22 characters. count text using count_text_length tool - color: #4c4c4c sub: - size:39 - line height: 44 - top padding: 16~20px from main - top padding: 13~16px from main if main and notice exists - maximum 22 characters. count text using count_text_length tool - color: #777777 notice: - size: 18 - line height: 21 - top padding: 18px~20px from sub OR from main if sub doesn't exist - color: #999999 - letter spacing: -0.09px - maximum 50 characters. count text using count_text_length tool chatroom: - icon - shape is rectangle - w=18,h=18 - background is fill with image and fill opacity is 100% - text - size:18 - line height: 21 - top padding 18~20px from sub OR from main if sub doesn't exist - left padding 8px from chatroom-icon - color: #999999 - dot - shape is vector - w=3,h=3 - color: #A6A6A6 - appearance and fill opacity is 100% - left and right margin 5px Output: - Return PASS if all validation checks pass. - Return FAIL if any validation check fails.
